tools.name: add_memory
tools.intent: Persist a durable, project-scoped fact with its source path — one fact per entry, never raw chatter.

tools.name: query
tools.intent: Search project/shared memory (scope=all, project, or shared) with 2-3 formulations before web or code search.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.intent: Read one memory entry's full content by the content hash a query or add_memory returned — fetch a full note after a search snippet, not to find notes.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.intent: Read one indexed code chunk's full source by its content hash from a kind=code or kind=both query hit — the code twin of get_entry.

tools.name: set_memory_usage_record
tools.intent: Record that the agent opened a file a prior query served, keyed by its correlationId — search-quality telemetry, not a memory write.

tools.name: set_query_result_grade
tools.intent: Grade a prior query call's usefulness 1-5 by its correlationId, with an optional note — human search-quality feedback, not entry rating.

tools.name: get_index
tools.intent: List entries in a project's memory bank, optionally filtered.

tools.name: get_store_statistics
tools.intent: Report bank size and entry counts for a project.

tools.name: share_memory
tools.intent: Promote a durable, cross-project entry to the shared tier — curated and never swept.

tools.name: trigger_memory_sharing
tools.intent: Scan committed project memories and queue ranked candidates for sharing into the propose tier, or promote the top queued ones — the batch path behind share_memory.

tools.name: get_memories_sharing_ranking
tools.intent: List the propose tier: candidates queued by trigger_memory_sharing and waiting for promotion review, ranked by score, previews by default.

tools.name: delete_memory_from_ranking
tools.intent: Drop a queued promotion candidate without sharing it, or clear the project's whole propose-tier queue when no hash is given.

tools.name: delete_entry
tools.intent: Delete a specific memory entry by id.

tools.name: delete_context
tools.intent: Delete entries by context; requires full access mode.

tools.name: ingest_file
tools.intent: Bulk-load a file's contents into project memory as entries.

tools.name: ingest_directory
tools.intent: Bulk-load every supported file under a directory into project memory.

tools.name: embed_deferred_entries
tools.intent: Embed pending entries; omit the limit argument to process all.

tools.name: initialize_workspace
tools.intent: Start an isolated workspace outbox for in-progress notes.

tools.name: get_workspace_status
tools.intent: List what the active workspace outbox holds.

tools.name: close_workspace
tools.intent: Finish a workspace: keep durable facts, promote cross-project ones with share_memory, drop the rest.

tools.name: discard_workspace
tools.intent: Discard an active workspace and its outbox without consolidating.

tools.name: trigger_memory_cleanup
tools.intent: Remove old, low-rated project entries; shared entries are exempt.

tools.name: set_memory_ttl
tools.intent: Set or clear one entry's per-entry TTL in days, the age half of the sweep rule; an entry still needs a low rating before trigger_memory_cleanup removes it.

tools.name: sync_to_cloud
tools.intent: Exchange memory snapshots with cloud storage when configured.

tools.name: add_watch
tools.intent: Register an absolute path to mirror into memory; the initial scan runs in the background.

tools.name: get_watch_status
tools.intent: Report watch state (scanning/healthy/retrying/stopped) for a project; empty when none.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.intent: Stop mirroring a watched path; a no-op when the path is not watched.

tools.name: get_engine_statistics
tools.intent: Report this project's server self-instrumentation: per-tool and per-search-phase latency percentiles and counts over a time window, for diagnosing slow memory calls.

tools.name: get_project_id
tools.intent: Look up the project id registered under an exact, case-sensitive project name; call it before minting, since every other tool takes that id.

tools.name: save_project_id_token
tools.intent: Mint and register a new project id (guidv7) once per project, only after get_project_id found no match for the name.
